request: Try alternative sources for difficult songs while keeping pure PWA and no intermediary server

candidate.articleAttribution: Iritsi da eguna - Pirritx eta Porrotx
candidate.notes: A real direct MP3, not a video iframe or preview URL. Leading/trailing silence explains much of its longer duration but does not identify the master, vocals or exact version. The first browser test's start-to-two-second advance occurs during known silence; its middle/end seek checks and decoded non-zero PCM provide separate evidence. No silent automatic substitution, trimming, threshold relaxation or claim of phone background playback.
candidate.desktopNormalFlagsCorroboration: Separate 4/4 directed checks use one trusted click from second 20, non-zero PCM evidence, real hidden tab for 30 seconds, no observer activation or launch flags disabling background throttling. Still not a phone or product test.

otherProviders.result: Three browser-readable valid searches by title, artist and ISRC text returned no results. Positive trending control returned a track. Only those searches are considered empty.
Two browser-readable advanced searches returned valid response.numFound=0 for the exact title and album/creator query. This is not a claim that all metadata spellings were exhausted.
Official testing-only public client returns suspended-application errors, including the positive-control request. No empty-catalog conclusion and no production use of that client.
Three public top-level searches reached a client challenge. No bypass was attempted; no empty-catalog conclusion.
Earlier separate investigation found matching full-duration metadata but no actual playback in three official-widget attempts. Not repeated or presented as a working source.

observerCorrections: The first CORS result was a test bug: Fetch Response.status is a property, not a function. A separate retest proves HTTP206 and readable 1024 bytes.

The first RMS probe read ArrayBuffer.byteLength after decodeAudioData detached it, yielding an invalid zero size. The original is preserved under an explicit observer-initial filename. A separate final fetch records the byte count and SHA256 before decoding.
integrationPlanIfVersionVerified: A possible curated-source integration was assessed but is not being prioritized after the user clarified they want broad searchable platform catalogs. No active source registry or provider adapter has been shipped.

userSourcePreference.clarificationVerbatim: Pero esa fuente no es un repositorio de fuentes como YouTube o SoundCloud
userSourcePreference.platformExamplesVerbatim: Amazon music, YouTube music, SoundCloud, Spotify...
userSourcePreference.interpretation: Prioritize searchable broad music-platform catalogs rather than a one-off ALEA song entry. The vocals answer does not establish original-master identity or authorize treating the ad-hoc source as a catalog solution.
